{{Top|leg}}
'''Hhintha''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Commenting on the entry for the [[QuickMed]] [[med-aid]], Hhintha noted that the collectors would pay good money for [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]-era med-aids.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
